SPECIFICATION FOR 

CARBIDE TIPPED LONG FLUTED MACHINE REAMER 

WITH MORSE TAPER SHANK 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and requirements for carbide tipped long fluted machine reamer with 
morse taper shanl<. 

2. Types 

Type A ~~ Straight flutes. 
Type B — Helical flutes. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Table 1 . 

4. Tolerances -- The tolerances of cutting length and overall length shall be as given below: 

All dimensions in millimetres.

5. General Requirements 

5.1 Back Taper— Reamers shall be provided with back taper on cutting edge diameter and the value 
of taper shall be within the limits of tolerance on the cutting edge diameter. 

5.2 Flutes, unless otherwise specified, shall be right hand cutting. 

5.3 The carbide tips shall be according to IS : 9327 - 1 979 'Dimensions for carbide tips for reamers, 
core drills, end mills and slot milling ctftters'. 

5.4 Other requirements shall as per IS : 1 0923 - 1 984 'Specification for technical supply conditions for 
carbide tipped and solid carbide reamers'. 

6. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be in accordance with IS : 7778 - 1975 
'Methods for sampling small tools'. 

7. Designation 

7.1 A carbide tipped long fluted machine reamer of Type A having diameter d = ^6 mm carbide tip 
of range of application KIO, conforming to this standard and suitable for a hole with tolerance H8 
shall be designated as: 

CT Machine Reamer A 1 6*0 IS : 1 1 936 K1 

7.2 When the reamer is required for a hole with the tolerance other than H8, the appropriate hole 
tolerance shall be included in the designation after size. 

8. Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

EXP L AN ATO R Y NOTE 

This standard has been prepared based on the current practices prevalent in the Indian industry.

tipped and solid carbide reamers'."
